notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/05516c132099b1f0c267dd7ccb849cd058a23d31.png
Hello Alchemists!
Today is finally the day we have been preparing together for almost a year of Early Access - 
1.0 Alchemist: The Potion Monger release!
With your help, we changed a game quite a lot since 16 Oct 2023.

Huge thanks to all of you on our Discord, Steam Discussions, and Social Media <3
Special thanks to Khontis, Knows Ajed, EverSilver, bluebird screaming, YoKai21: Potion Game Connoissuer, and Khanita Zaheer from our Discord who helped us find bugs in the final beta tests before release.

The 1.0 Patch
Our biggest update to date consists of lots of new content for you to play with and some of the most requested fixes!

HIGHLIGHTS
POTION BUNDLES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/18582286dfe57aa1383b9cb7747821cafe4d32f2.jpg
Brand new activity for you to take part in and gain unique items in the process!
Prepare specific potion combinations for specific NPCs to help them in their tasks.
Talk with the Bartender when you reach Reputation level 4 to start.

MATT THE LIGHTHOUSE KEEPER AND HIS QUEST
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/9c305eb0bfad1809860d43cc1db0c0af6c9b6c45.jpg
The lighthouse is now open and you'll find this humble mouse inside.
He likes to fish when he's not busy watching over the lighthouse, and will likely share with you some of his catches. 
He has a problem and you might be just the right anthropomorphic person for the job...

NEW ENEMIES - WOLVES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/375ca1d5aa2c5477828bc24594e32bb30b421c59.jpg
Ferocious and hungry, way more wild distant relatives of your dog. Can't be tamed and will attack on sight, often in packs. Watch out alchemists. When defeated will award you with Wolf Tooth.

BEDS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/f687395a05ca8f76e536fdbce76c8feba035432c.jpg
The most anticipated furniture is finally here! No more sleeping on the floor. Beds come in various colours so everyone should be able to find something for themselves. Visit your local furniture seller now!

ATTIC
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/39b90115578840f6c78cc77229acfeeb9972bbe6.jpg
The attic is now no longer under construction, which makes your house 1/3x (very precise architectural calculations) bigger now!

MAY THE CHAOS TAKE THE WORLD!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/97d65db14e2fbd9712b6d660d0ace0f3d5a290f6.jpg
Make the NPCs fight among themselves with the new potions - Potion of Aggression, Potion of War, and Potion of Madness. Purchase the recipes (look for them at Eve's, Winterlands, and Calypso's), brew, and cause a ruckus!

???
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/bbb421237a1cfbc0a3218ee6ec9ec157aebb4352.jpg
Visit the Farmlands after siding with Eve. And welcome a new guest...

OTHERS

The Swamplands water is now poisonous, take Poison Immunity Potion when venturing there!
Cave/Potion of Light rework!
 The credits section is now visible, if you helped the development process you might find your name/nickname there!
some minor bug fixes

Thanks again to everyone who has been with us during the Early Access phase of Alchemist: The Potion Monger <3
It was quite a journey!

If you want to talk about the game/chat with the devs feel free to hop onto our Discord server.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/2f42b19904995a0ec6e10833d264ca79733e6106.png

Take care, till next time!
AGS Team

notes.notes:

Hello Alchemists!
We present the next Alchemist: The Potion Monger heavy bug-fixing update! It contains a slight rework of the player market stall and a new skill to highlight it.
Welcome Patch #8 - Know your Customer and destroy bugs!
Thanks for reporting that many bugs (as always especially to @Waffles from our Discord), this won't be possible by ourselves. 
Take a look at the update:

HIGHLIGHTS
Know your Customer!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/bd2eca0472ba74fe80efcb377cf0f0eb6c1e376d.jpg

We have reworked a player stall potion selling system by adding the new skill - Know your Customer. After completing its related task, it allows you to see what prices for what potion are appropriate based on the color scheme. Light Green - very easy to sell, to Dark Red - very hard to sell.
Visit the fellow brew seller - the Bartender to learn more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/d2839e8c4324656f1dc3a9d1505022ef5c64d868.jpg

All the trade-related skills and potions have been reworked to work with the new system, which means they no longer grant you bonus gold but increase the probability of buying for your set price instead!
The context menu now properly shows moving whole stacks to the counter.

OTHERS

 Botteled Snowstorm is now way more powerful
 Wild grass is no longer that wild
 Changed Ingredient to Item on the Composter feedback
 Skill book prices rebalance
 Removed redundant signpost on the Herbalands
 Fixed Slime King poster text leaving its textbox in some languages

 Resurrection Potion description no longer lies
 Contracts popup updated
 Eve no longer repeats herself

 Fireworks philosopher stone recipe fixed

 Player no longer drowns in the Swampland shallow water
 Fixed disappearing sacks in the Market and the Dump
 Fixed Bandit King's tent colliders
 Fixed roof tiles of the Church
 Fixed colliders of the lamps
 Cave music plays in the right place now
 The context menu no longer appears through the Almanac
 Bob now has the right idle dialogue during the Slimy Fertilizer quest
 The bartender no longer greats through the wall
 Characters no longer blink at the same time
 The priest cap no longer disappears
 Siting characters no longer rotate to a player during dialogues
 Dog no longer breathes underwater

notes.title: Patch #5 - Christmas and Priest Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/66eb6a020638d951323f513dfbe6916fd430df3f.jpg
Hello Alchemists!
We proudly present the third step of our Road Map - the fifth and so far the biggest Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch - The Christmas and Priest Update.
It brings loads of new content and is the first patch to include a new Character, Quest, Potions, and Animal!
Take a look:

HIGHLIGHTS

New face on the Island - Peter, The Towns Priest!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/2f480abec22fcaae7c51f97d400a348472df9553.jpg
Ever wondered why the Towns got a church but did not have a priest? You'll find answers in this update.
Let us welcome Peter, the rumored brother of Pablo the Mayor back from the pilgrimage to the Golden Trough. He'll appear once you reach reputation level 4!

New quest!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/611a20630429437cbc9b694d0cf470dc16c11851.jpg
Help Peter appease the Golden Hog using a brand new potion (and a bunch of old ones) and gain a new skill, as well as a new potion recipe!

Baaaaaaaa!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/0fe2a15851f31712567da4abd0a7d1dececc8854.jpg
Ever wanted to be an alchemical shepherd? You did not? erm... Now you can! Buy your own sheep (or acquire them in some other way...) and start shaving them for the new alchemical ingredient - Wool!

New Potions!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/515df4130d18af6e5440fc881bd246f86043bb69.jpg
Learn the recipes for 3 new potions. We're not going to spoil anything for you here find them out by yourself. [spoiler] ask Peter about them [/spoiler]

CHRISTMAS IS HERE!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/fb66ade3ab1f2d0548c50c3600dbdcb451def8d0.jpg
It's finally that time of the year! Feel the Xmas spirit walking around the decorated Town market and find snowmen in the Winterlands. Don't forget to purchase a Christmas Tree from Peter, for the Santa Pig to lay gifts under! Check it every day till the 5th of January.


OTHERS

 Fixed audio effects of some potions duplicating themselves
 Corner Shelf placing fixed
 Fixed some quests to block themselves when the player performs certain actions too early
 Thunder sound added to the Lightning Potion
 Fixed grass disappearing in the Hunter region
 Fixed indefinitely cow milking bug
 Fixed "Snake Nuggets" achievement not registering properly for some players


With this update, we continue our Road Map patches cycle, new ones coming every 2/3 weeks
Stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/6978afc8faa60631bb420b5243f0ec355da56f5b.jpg

notes.title: Patch #4 - Almanac Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/b0d993e8351cdc9db0b47d2f98e3791dc9cd053e.png
Hello Alchemists!
We present the second step of our Road Map - the fourth Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch - The Storage Update, this time on Tuesday.
It will greatly refine the quality of your alchemical life by improving the interface, map, and Almanac.
Here is what's new!

HIGHLIGHTS
Almanac Organization!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/7d0062bb5d2c3a573d0896957671c7cd5488925b.png
Now you can reach your favorite things in your Book way easier. Potion recipes and Automatic Potions are now sorted by name, it is also possible to find them in the new dedicated search field!
It's now also way easier to click on the pins, their colliders now take half of the bar.
You can find symbols in the top right corner of the page indicating the bookmark you are on.

Map Upgrade!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/f6f393800a9c3f2ae9311e41b2893f94ed663af1.png
After you find the Ingredient, its location will appear on the map (not including the plants appearing all around the Island), helping you find the things you need that you previously encountered.
You can also find out your character rotation regarding the map, thanks to the new player's marker.

Ingredients Interface!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/19d44168a48d449b09fd3c85a564f582deefac14.png
Alchemical Ingredients now have a better 3D interface showing their Aspects (similar to that of discovering them). 

OTHERS

 The spoon in the cauldron should no longer get in the way of the bubbles that often (it will be always on your right side)
 Better settings window 
 Almanac is now easier to navigate on the gamepad
 Solid state of matter no longer has a stone symbol (was a bit misleading)
 New Town fountain look
 Chest stack moving bug fixed
 Fixed effects of some potions not appearing (Holly Nuke, Unholy Nuke, and more...)
 Prettier trees trunks
 Better-looking Towns buildings
 Ingredients in the Almanac now show their descriptions properly
 Fixed the bug in the MY HEARTIES quest
 HERB COMPENDIUM - ... loading bug fixed 
 Screen resolutions are no longer doubled (for some even tripled) in the settings
 X and OK symbols are now in appropriate colors
 Fixed infinite Diamonds in the bandit's chest
 New effect when creating the automatic potions
 Furniture now can be dropped
 Contracts now display the time left

With this update, we continue our Road Map patches cycle, new ones coming every 2/3 weeks
Stay tuned!

Hello Alchemists!
We present the first step of our Road Map - the third Alchemist: The Potion Monger patch - The Storage Update.

HIGHLIGHTS
Chests are now available for purchase!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/71cf5c51a398024fee20e5b3d3e916790f7aae8c.png

We know how frustrating moving the shelves was, and that's why we implemented the function to reposition them with your items!


OTHERS

 Cows now spawn flies
 Cloud Save is now fully functional
 Road Map can now be accessed from the game's Main Menu
 The Cave in the Farmlands is now a little easier to get through
 Contract value and reputation gain should now appear properly in the Almanac in every language

 Chest in the Bandits Camp now has better, more shiny loot
 Optimized picking up great numbers of items from the shelves
 New context menu for picking items from shelves
 No more pink effects on the Stove
 You can now purchase potion recipes and skills with the full inventory
 Foxes no more wag their tails when dead
 Picked-up recipes and skill books no longer respawn after some time
 Skeletons now play proper sound effects when hit and when dying
 Furniture can now be placed in the corners behind doors
 Picking from shelves on the gamepad no longer causes one to pick up the whole shelf

With this update, we start our Road Map patches cycle, the next ones coming every 2/3 weeks.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/1d2e9b3c665455a7e36d01bfbda93ea685b7a5da.png
Hello Alchemists!
Since the demo ended we've been working hard on the game development, we've added a bunch of new things, as well as working on improving the existing ones, mostly the tutorial to make the alchemy more accessible and understandable for everyone!
We also adding new Alchemical Tools to enrichen the potion crafting process and make it possible to create more advanced potions.

Tutorial Rework
Based on the feedback from the Steam Fest Demo, we figured out the in-game tutorial was not doing the best work introducing some players to the alchemy system. Mostly the concept of Alchemical Aspects was not understood by everyone. Some of you also didn't like that they were too many pop-ups, which slowed the initial experience down to mutch. 

So we made the following changes:
1. Now you'll work with only one ingredient - Calendula at the start instead of 3 ingredients at once.
2. You are familiar with all four basic Earth Aspects from the beginning 
3. Removed pop-ups from the obvious things (such as placing the chest) and the ones that repeated themselves
4. Added a bit of combat to the tutorial.
5. Closed the tutorial area (you'll have to find out for yourself how...) 

New Tools
In the Demo, players can acquire only the most basic Alchemical Tools, now we're working on adding more to your arsenal. 
Keep in mind that all models are still untextured work in progress. 

1. Electrostatic Generator - who said a bit of new technology can't be useful for the alchemist?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/f6f1836cc713bd36708438cc7c7a027537078f33.jpg
Tool generating high voltage electricity, that changes all the Aspects in the ingredient to their mirror image on the Great Aspect Wheel 

2. Alembic- a true classic.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/ea56777b289ef9d0f9865351eb3188482e946337.jpg
Widely recognized machine deleting the highest tier Aspects from the Ingredient.

3. Retort- broadly used tool, of high, fair reputation 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/96dba9b87e91dfe012350d2b222c881051e8847c.jpg
Used by the generations of alchemists to evaporate the Aspects of the lowest tiers from the Ingredients. Greatly useful. 

4. Composter- it might be stinky, but it's rotting from the inside too
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982753/40f14ec4bb752164c56acc8965ce19ce8e633624.jpg
Not an alchemy tool to be exact, but a useful one. It can create rotten/spoiled forms of ingredients ( e.g. Carrot > Rotten Carrot, Apple > Rotten Apple, etc.) 


That's all for now, 
let us know how you like the changes and additions.

Stay tuned for more updates!
Work Work...
AGS Team
